## Description

SMS adapter (Azure Communication Services where supported, otherwise a DLT-registered aggregator) behind the Notifications interface. India messages use the registered DLT template IDs and sender; UAE uses its approved sender. Delivery receipts update NOTIFICATION_ATTEMPT. Reminder delivery rate is computed per clinic.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** SMS uses only registered templates; a message not matching a registered template is not sent (validation test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Delivery receipts are processed (webhook verified/authenticated) and update status; failures are visible to reception.
- [ ] **AC3.** Delivery rate dashboard shows ≥ 98 % delivered during the pilot or lists every failure with reason (exit gate 4).
- [ ] **AC4.** Messages contain no clinical details; sender name is the clinic's.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
